def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)

    def draw_border(top, bottom, left, right, color):
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            out[top][c] = out[bottom][c] = color
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            out[r][left] = out[r][right] = color

    def decorate(top, bottom, left, right):
        # Two nested outlines, then repeat the pattern on a 5 outline
        # separated from the current frame by one blank cell.
        for inset, color in ((1, 2), (2, 5)):
            t, b = top + inset, bottom - inset
            l, r = left + inset, right - inset
            if t <= b and l <= r:
                draw_border(t, b, l, r, color)
        t, b = top + 4, bottom - 4
        l, r = left + 4, right - 4
        if t <= b and l <= r:
            draw_border(t, b, l, r, 5)
            decorate(t, b, l, r)

    decorate(r0, r1, c0, c1)
    return out
